title: Mouse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 70 Q88 66 84 50 Q82 42 74 46' fill='none' stroke='#f2a3c0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M40 78 Q34 86 28 82' fill='none' stroke='#b9c4d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 78 Q68 86 74 80' fill='none' stroke='#b9c4d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='83' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='81' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#b9c4d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#d9e2f0'/>
  <!-- arms raised, dancing -->
  <path d='M36 58 Q22 50 20 36' fill='none' stroke='#b9c4d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 58 Q78 50 82 38' fill='none' stroke='#b9c4d8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='34' r='5' fill='#f2a3c0'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='36' r='5' fill='#f2a3c0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='11' fill='#b9c4d8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='6' fill='#f2a3c0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='11' fill='#b9c4d8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='6' fill='#f2a3c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='18' fill='#b9c4d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#d9e2f0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#2b2150'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#2b2150'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3' fill='#f2a3c0'/>
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 56 56 50' fill='none' stroke='#2b2150' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M40 46 L30 43 M40 50 L30 52' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 46 L70 43 M60 50 L70 52' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <circle cx='88' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='90' y='10' width='2' height='12'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='16' r='3'/>
    <rect x='14' y='4' width='2' height='12'/>
  </g>
</svg>
